hints.title: Shared Email Equivalence Merge Obstacle
hints.text: Accounts that share even a single email address belong to the same person. How can linking every subsequent email to the first email in an account cluster all aliases under a unified representative?

hints.title: Component Connected Email Invariant
hints.text: Shared emails define connected components over the email set. Merging all emails within each individual record groups overlapping accounts into disjoint components.

hints.title: Disjoint Set Email Grouping Procedure
hints.text: Assign each unique email to a parent mapping initialized to itself and record its owner name. In each account, union every subsequent email with the first email. Group all emails by their canonical representative, sort the emails within each group, and prepend the account name. Return the list of merged accounts.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: E: total number of emails across all accounts
complexity.notes: DSU unions each email in near-linear time; sorting emails in each connected component dominates.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise account intersection checks take O(N^2 * E) which is too slow.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Email parent and name dictionaries require O(E) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Using DSU on email strings directly or mapping emails to integer IDs.

solutions.approach: String-based disjoint set union with email canonical grouping
